mapper.select:
select * from om_cloud_site_tbl ocst where 1=1
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)

SELECT resource_type, COUNT(*) AS all_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN resource_status > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opt_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN 0 > resource_status THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unOpt_cnt, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN resource_status > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*)) AS percent FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE resource_type > 0
AND 5 > resource_type
AND resource_type > 4
AND resource_org_size > 0
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
GROUP BY resource_type;

WITH resource_types AS ( SELECT DISTINCT resource_type FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE resource_type > 0 ) SELECT rt.resource_type, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ocot.resource_org_size), 1), 0) AS resource_org_size, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ocot.resource_type1_size), 1), 0) AS resource_type1_size, COALESCE( ROUND( CASE WHEN AVG(ocot.resource_org_size) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AVG(ocot.resource_org_size) - AVG(ocot.resource_type1_size)) / AVG(ocot.resource_org_size)) * 100 END ), 0 ) AS percent FROM resource_types rt LEFT JOIN om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot ON rt.resource_type = ocot.resource_type AND ocot.resource_org_size > 0 AND ocot.resource_type1_size > 0
AND ocot.site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
GROUP BY rt.resource_type ORDER BY rt.resource_type;

WITH resource_types AS ( SELECT DISTINCT resource_type FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE resource_type > 0 ) SELECT rt.resource_type, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ocot.org_time), 1), 0) AS org_time, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ocot.new_time), 1), 0) AS new_time, COALESCE( ROUND( CASE WHEN AVG(ocot.org_time) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AVG(ocot.org_time) - AVG(ocot.new_time)) / AVG(ocot.org_time)) * 100 END ), 0 ) AS percent FROM resource_types rt LEFT JOIN om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot ON rt.resource_type = ocot.resource_type AND ocot.org_time > 0 AND ocot.new_time > 0
AND ocot.site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
GROUP BY rt.resource_type ORDER BY rt.resource_type;

WITH resource_types AS ( SELECT DISTINCT resource_type FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE resource_type > 4 ) select rt.resource_type, COALESCE( ROUND( CASE WHEN 0 >= AVG(ocot.resource_org_size) THEN 0 ELSE ((AVG(ocot.resource_org_size) - AVG(ocot.resource_new_size_type2)) / AVG(ocot.resource_org_size)) * 100 END ), 0 ) AS percent FROM resource_types rt LEFT JOIN om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot ON rt.resource_type = ocot.resource_type and resource_org_size >0 and resource_new_size_type2 >0 and resource_status ='1' group by rt.resource_type

SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ((org_time - new_time) * 100.0 / org_time) desc) AS no, resource_name, org_time, new_time, ROUND( CASE WHEN org_time = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (org_time - new_time) * 100.0 / org_time END, 1 ) AS percent, resource_status FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE org_time != new_time
AND 5 > resource_type
AND resource_type > 4
and resource_type = #{resource_type}
AND resource_status = #{resource_status}
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY percent desc, no asc LIMIT 10

SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ((org_time - new_time) * 100.0 / org_time) asc) AS no, resource_name, org_time, new_time, ROUND( CASE WHEN org_time = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (org_time - new_time) * 100.0 / org_time END, 1 ) AS percent, resource_status FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE org_time != new_time
AND 5 > resource_type
AND resource_type > 4
and resource_type = #{resource_type}
AND resource_status = #{resource_status}
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY percent asc, no asc LIMIT 10

SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER by ROUND(((CAST(resource_org_size AS DECIMAL) - CAST(resource_new_size_type2 AS DECIMAL)) / CAST(resource_org_size AS DECIMAL) * 100), 1) desc) as no , resource_name, resource_org_size, resource_new_size_type2, ROUND(((CAST(resource_org_size AS DECIMAL) - CAST(resource_new_size_type2 AS DECIMAL)) / CAST(resource_org_size AS DECIMAL) * 100), 1) AS percent FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE resource_org_size > 0 AND resource_new_size_type2 > 0 AND resource_status = '1'
AND resource_type > 4
and resource_type = #{resource_type}
AND resource_status = #{resource_status}
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
limit 10

SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER by ROUND(((CAST(resource_org_size AS DECIMAL) - CAST(resource_new_size_type2 AS DECIMAL)) / CAST(resource_org_size AS DECIMAL) * 100), 1)) as no, resource_name, resource_org_size, resource_new_size_type2, ROUND(((CAST(resource_org_size AS DECIMAL) - CAST(resource_new_size_type2 AS DECIMAL)) / CAST(resource_org_size AS DECIMAL) * 100), 1) AS percent FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE resource_org_size > 0 AND resource_new_size_type2 > 0 AND resource_status = '1'
AND resource_type > 4
and resource_type = #{resource_type}
AND resource_status = #{resource_status}
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
limit 10

select ocort.page_no ,sum(ocot.org_time) AS org_time,sum(ocot.new_time) AS new_time, ROUND( CASE WHEN AVG(org_time) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AVG(org_time) - AVG(new_time)) / AVG(org_time)) * 100 END ) AS percent, (select site_address from om_cloud_site_tbl ocst where 1=1
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
) as site_address, (select page_url from om_cloud_optimizer_page_tbl where page_no = ocort.page_no) as page_url from om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot join om_cloud_optimizer_rel_tbl ocort on ocot.resource_no = ocort.resource_no where 1=1
AND ocot.site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
and ocot.new_time >0 and ocot.resource_type >0 group by ocort.page_no order by percent desc limit 1

select row_number() OVER (ORDER by ROUND( CASE WHEN AVG(org_time) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AVG(org_time) - AVG(new_time)) / AVG(org_time)) * 100 END ,1) desc ) as no, ocort.page_no ,sum(ocot.org_time) AS org_time,sum(ocot.new_time) AS new_time, ROUND( CASE WHEN AVG(org_time) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AVG(org_time) - AVG(new_time)) / AVG(org_time)) * 100 END ,1) AS percent, (select site_address from om_cloud_site_tbl ocst where 1=1
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
) as site_address, (select page_url from om_cloud_optimizer_page_tbl where page_no = ocort.page_no) as page_url from om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot join om_cloud_optimizer_rel_tbl ocort on ocot.resource_no = ocort.resource_no where 1=1
AND ocot.site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
and ocot.new_time >0 and ocot.resource_type >0
and resource_type = #{resource_type}
group by ocort.page_no order by percent desc LIMIT 10

select row_number() OVER (ORDER by ROUND( CASE WHEN AVG(org_time) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AVG(org_time) - AVG(new_time)) / AVG(org_time)) * 100 END ,1) asc ) as no, ocort.page_no ,sum(ocot.org_time) AS org_time,sum(ocot.new_time) AS new_time, ROUND( CASE WHEN AVG(org_time) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AVG(org_time) - AVG(new_time)) / AVG(org_time)) * 100 END ,1) AS percent, (select site_address from om_cloud_site_tbl ocst where 1=1
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
) as site_address, (select page_url from om_cloud_optimizer_page_tbl where page_no = ocort.page_no) as page_url from om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot join om_cloud_optimizer_rel_tbl ocort on ocot.resource_no = ocort.resource_no where 1=1
AND ocot.site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
and ocot.new_time >0 and ocot.resource_type >0
and resource_type = #{resource_type}
group by ocort.page_no order by percent asc LIMIT 10

select ocort.page_no ,sum(ocot.org_time) AS org_time,sum(ocot.new_time) AS new_time, ROUND( CASE WHEN AVG(org_time) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((AVG(org_time) - AVG(new_time)) / AVG(org_time)) * 100 END ,1) AS percent, (select site_address from om_cloud_site_tbl ocst where 1=1
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
) as site_address, (select page_url from om_cloud_optimizer_page_tbl where page_no = ocort.page_no) as page_url from om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot join om_cloud_optimizer_rel_tbl ocort on ocot.resource_no = ocort.resource_no where 1=1
AND ocot.site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
and ocot.new_time >0 and ocot.resource_type >0 group by ocort.page_no order by percent desc

select ROW_NUMBER() over (order by resource_type,resource_new_size_type2 ) as no,resource_no ,resource_type,resource_name,resource_status,resource_org_size ,resource_new_size_type2 from om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot where 1=1 and resource_org_size >0 and resource_type>0
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
AND 5 > resource_type
AND resource_type > 4
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
order by resource_type, resource_new_size_type2 asc

select ROW_NUMBER() over (order by resource_no ) as no,resource_no ,resource_type,resource_name,resource_status,org_time ,new_time, resource_org_size, resource_type1_size from om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot where 1=1 and resource_type > 0 and resource_org_size >0 and resource_status = '1'
AND 5 > resource_type
AND resource_type > 4
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)

select main.resource_type,main.al_type,sum(main.greatest_type) as total_bytes , (select algorithm_name from om_algorithm oa where algorithm_type = main.resource_type and al_type= main.al_type ) from ( SELECT resource_type, case WHEN resource_type IN (1, 2) THEN greatest( resource_org_size-resource_type1_size, resource_org_size-resource_type2_size, resource_org_size-resource_type3_size, resource_org_size-resource_type4_size ) WHEN resource_type IN (3, 4) THEN greatest( resource_org_size-resource_type1_size, resource_org_size-resource_type2_size, resource_org_size-resource_type3_size ) ELSE greatest( resource_org_size-resource_type1_size ) END AS greatest_type, case WHEN resource_type IN (1, 2) THEN case WHEN GREATEST( resource_org_size - resource_type1_size, resource_org_size - resource_type2_size, resource_org_size - resource_type3_size, resource_org_size - resource_type4_size ) = resource_org_size - resource_type1_size THEN 1 WHEN GREATEST( resource_org_size - resource_type1_size, resource_org_size - resource_type2_size, resource_org_size - resource_type3_size, resource_org_size - resource_type4_size ) = resource_org_size - resource_type2_size THEN 2 WHEN GREATEST( resource_org_size - resource_type1_size, resource_org_size - resource_type2_size, resource_org_size - resource_type3_size, resource_org_size - resource_type4_size ) = resource_org_size - resource_type3_size THEN 3 WHEN GREATEST( resource_org_size - resource_type1_size, resource_org_size - resource_type2_size, resource_org_size - resource_type3_size, resource_org_size - resource_type4_size ) = resource_org_size - resource_type4_size THEN 4 end
WHEN resource_type IN (3, 4) THEN CASE WHEN GREATEST( resource_org_size - resource_type1_size, resource_org_size - resource_type2_size, resource_org_size - resource_type3_size ) = resource_org_size - resource_type1_size THEN 1 WHEN GREATEST( resource_org_size - resource_type1_size, resource_org_size - resource_type2_size, resource_org_size - resource_type3_size ) = resource_org_size - resource_type2_size THEN 2 WHEN GREATEST( resource_org_size - resource_type1_size, resource_org_size - resource_type2_size, resource_org_size - resource_type3_size ) = resource_org_size - resource_type3_size THEN 3 END ELSE CASE WHEN GREATEST( resource_org_size - resource_type1_size ) = resource_org_size - resource_type1_size THEN 1
END END as al_type FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE 1=1 and 0 > resource_status and resource_org_size >0 and resource_type >0
AND 5 > resource_type
AND resource_type > 4
AND site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
) main
group by main.resource_type,main.al_type order by resource_type

resource_type1_size, resource_org_size - resource_type2_size, resource_org_size - resource_type3_size, resource_org_size - resource_type4_size ) = resource_org_size - resource_type1_size THEN 1 WHEN GREATEST( resource_org_size - resource_type1_size, resource_org_size - resource_type2_size, resource_org_size - resource_type3_size, resource_org_size - resource_type4_size ) = resource_org_size - resource_type4_size THEN 4 END WHEN resource_type IN (3, 4) THEN CASE WHEN GREATEST( resource_org_size - AND 5 > resource_type
